title: Windowsill herbs without a hydro kit #Shorts
description: Pot-and-soil herbs that work on a real apartment sill — light, watering, and which plants to skip.

slides.headline:
Windowsill herbs without
a hydro kit
slides.subhead: Pot-and-soil herbs that work on a real apartment sill — light, watering, and which plants to skip.
slides.narration: Windowsill herbs without a hydro kit. The Sill Garden answer for a small apartment, without buying more equipment than you need.

slides.headline:
Match the setup
to your space.
slides.subhead: Light, noise, and spill risk matter more than pod count.
slides.narration: Start with usable space, daylight, and a tray that protects the rental surface. Then pick the smallest setup that still grows what you cook.

slides.headline:
Don't buy the
biggest kit first.
slides.subhead: Weak light is not a watering problem.
slides.narration: Skip the largest system until the plants prove they need it. Stretching stems usually mean more light, not more water.

slides.headline:
Start small.
Prove the routine.
slides.subhead: Start with basil, mint, and chives in small pots if you have a bright sill. Add a cheap clip-on grow light before you blame your “black thum
slides.narration: Our verdict: Start with basil, mint, and chives in small pots if you have a bright sill. Add a cheap clip-on grow light before you blame your “black thumb.” Full guide on Sill Garden dot com.
